items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Benny Goodman and I studied for about a year and a half there. Harmonies and arranging.

ctx.x: Oh yes. Bix and I and all the Austin Highschool Gang, Benny Goodman and so forth. We used to go out and hear Bessie Smith at a place called Dreamland out on the West Side of Chicago. And she was something. But Ethel Waters to me, Ethel Waters sang you know.
Yes I have several of her records here. I have her records collector's items.
